{{Top|leg}}
'''Spun-plast''' was a type of material used in making [[Boot/Legends|boots]]. It was extremely tough yet pliable, and had the quality of being able to turn the edge of a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] or [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] blade.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] wore spun-plast boots during her stay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Appearances==
*''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''
